Jun Min Lu, He Fei Shi, China

Filmed in Feidong County (31.98 degrees north latitude, 117.60 degrees east longitude) in Hefei, Anhui province, various CCTV footages showed shop owner, diners, parents and kids, etc. rushed out of houses into the open space for safety as the 4.7-magnitude earthquake strike at a focal depth of 12 kilometers.
This is the fourth earthquake in Feidong County this year.
Anhui is affected by the joint action of the Pacific and Indian plates and the east-west compression, which easily leads to northeast-trending and northeast-trending faults.
Liangyuan in Feidong is located at the junction of the Tanlu fault in the northeast and the Feidong fault in the near east-west direction.
Under the joint action of the stress field, it is prone to frequent small and medium earthquakes.
The video was provided with permission from local media.
